fact: In interviews in five regions between October 2023 and March 2024, a primary health care unit head said health posts send their data to health centres by day 23 and health centres finalise reports by day 26, and a regional HMIS expert said facilities with a computer and electricity but no internet enter data into DHIS2 offline and carry it by flash drive to a connected site, while numerous facilities lack internet, computers or reliable power for DHIS2.
title: Unveiling the role of DHIS2 in enhancing data quality and accessibility in primary healthcare facilities: Evidence from Ethiopia
